data_payload.verdict: Approved with methodological and textual reservations

evaluation_summary.continuum_kinematics_and_1d_reduction: High rigor: exact tensor mappings (F, C, E, S, sigma), proper isochoric-volumetric decomposition, and flawless 1D uniaxial reduction under transverse isotropy and incompressibility (J = 1). Methodological gap: omission of tare pre-load / initial pre-strain boundary condition to establish gauge length L_0 and reference configuration Omega_0.
evaluation_summary.constitutive_formulations_and_citations: All 6 constitutive models (HGO, Fung exponential, Mooney-Rivlin, Ogden, Yeoh, Fung QLV continuous spectrum) formulated with parameter definitions and specific page citations. Flaws: C_10 mislabeled as shear modulus instead of neo-Hookean parameter in HGO; missing Gasser et al. (2006) citation for fiber dispersion kappa; and line 643 contains an incomplete/flawed ramp-corrected QLV integral during the relaxation hold phase.
evaluation_summary.catalog_and_doi_verification: 60 of 60 studies independently verified and active via direct doi.org/CrossRef resolution (100% active, zero hallucination). Distributed across 4 classes: 19 TPU/PU, 24 Hydrogels/IPN, 10 Braided/Fibers, 7 Elastomers/Silicones. Textual glitches: Study 6 has a truncated opening with a dangling closing parenthesis, and Study 54 starts with an incomplete lowercase clause.
evaluation_summary.formatting_math_and_sig_figs: Strict adherence to GitHub Markdown and KaTeX math delimiters ($...$ inline and $$...$$ display). Significant figures policy (3 sig figs) adhered to across text, with minor 2-sig-fig parameter specifications in the FEBio XML snippet.

actionable_feedback.issue: Incomplete and mathematically flawed formulation of the ramp-corrected Fung QLV hereditary integral during the relaxation holding phase (t > t_0). For s > t_0, strain is constant (d(epsilon)/ds = 0), so the second integral vanishes identically; the formula also terminates abruptly with '\dots'.
actionable_feedback.fix: Replace line 643 with the exact closed-form ramp-corrected QLV integral for a constant strain rate ramp: \sigma(t) = \frac{\varepsilon_0}{t_0} \int_0^{t_0} G(t - s) \left.\frac{\partial \sigma^e}{\partial \varepsilon}\right|_{\varepsilon(s)} ds for t \ge t_0.

actionable_feedback.issue: Hidden boundary condition: omission of tare pre-load / initial pre-strain boundary condition to establish reference configuration Omega_0 and gauge length L_0. In flaccid ligaments and tendons, strain origin is indeterminate without specifying tare pre-load.
actionable_feedback.fix: Explicitly declare the experimental tare pre-load protocol (e.g. F_0 = 0.100 - 0.500 N applied quasi-statically at <= 0.100 mm/s) required to establish the undeformed reference configuration Omega_0 (where E = 0, \lambda = 1.00) prior to tensile assay.

actionable_feedback.issue: (a) Dispersion parameter \kappa in [0, 1/3] was introduced by Gasser, Ogden, and Holzapfel (2006), but only Holzapfel et al. (2000) is cited. (b) C_10 is mislabeled as 'isotropic matrix shear modulus' instead of neo-Hookean stress-scaling parameter (ground shear modulus \mu_m = 2 C_10).
actionable_feedback.fix: (a) Append canonical citation: Gasser, T. C., Ogden, R. W., Holzapfel, G. A., Hyperelastic modelling of arterial layers with distributed collagen fibre orientations, J. R. Soc. Interface, vol. 3, 2006, pp. 15-35, specifically pp. 17-20. (b) Amend line 151 to: 'C_{10} > 0: isotropic matrix stress-scaling parameter (where ground shear modulus \mu_m = 2 C_{10}, in MPa)'.

actionable_feedback.issue: Truncated opening sentence and dangling closing parenthesis in abstract: 'Background: ) remains a significant challenge due to their nonlinear...'
actionable_feedback.fix: Restore complete opening clause: 'Background: Characterizing dynamic fracture and rate-dependent cavitation in soft materials remains a significant challenge due to their nonlinear, large-deformation, and rate-dependent mechanical behavior...'

actionable_feedback.issue: Incomplete opening sentence starting with lowercase: 'forming hydrogels were composed of different ionic crosslinked alginate concentrations...'
actionable_feedback.fix: Capitalize and complete opening sentence: 'In situ forming hydrogels were composed of different ionic crosslinked alginate concentrations with 1% w/v enzymatically crosslinked phenolized cartilage ECM, resulting in an interpenetrating polymer network (IPN)...'

actionable_feedback.issue: Simulation parameters in FEBio XML snippet are formatted with 2 significant figures (1.5e-15, 2.2, 0.50, 0.10, 2.5), departing from the project-wide 3 significant figures policy.
actionable_feedback.fix: Format all continuous simulation parameters to 3 significant figures: <perm>1.50e-15</perm>, <M>2.20</M>, <c1>0.500</c1>, <c2>0.100</c2>, <alpha>2.50</alpha>.
